name: Sparkplug B — Publish Device Telemetry to a SCADA Host
description: Every 30 seconds, read environmental sensor data and publish it as a Sparkplug B NDATA so an Ignition, Honeywell EBI or any Tahu-compatible host consumes it directly. The device is its own edge node — no industrial gateway in between. Requires MQTT and Sparkplug B enabled in Settings, with matching metrics declared there.
